reviews.title: Best damn keyboard around.
reviews.comment:
Feel free to judge me but I love the wheel for adjusting volume. Not gonna lie, it’s easy and makes my life easier lol
As far as the rest of the keyboard goes, it’s really durable and feels heavy. Not super heavy but that heavy that lets you know it’s well made. The rgb lighting is not super brite even on the highest setting and I like that. It’s pretty comfortable to use and connects as easy as any other keyboard.
If I was forced to find a negative comment it would be the keys feel closer to each other than a lot of other keyboards so fat fingering can be an issue.
reviews.author: Russell

reviews.title: keyboard is ok.  software is absolute trash.
reviews.comment:
It has a lot of really annoying light settings.  Some that are actually ok.  But the profiles don't work unless the software is running.  There's supposed to be a way to save the profiles to the keyboard, but it simply does not work.  It's an ok mechanical keyboard.  The feel is fine.  The layout is fine.  But good luck assigning those annoying g keys, or assigning a lighting pattern that won't annoy you unless you keep their software constantly running.
Update.  Changing to one star.  Because if you turn off the ridiculous distracting lightshow, you can't even see what key you're pressing anymore.  This is worthless.
reviews.author: J

reviews.title: Great keyboard!
reviews.comment: I love this keyboard. It's my first mechanical, and they keys are a lot more sensitive than my other keyboard, so it's taken some time to get used to it. Lighting is nice. It's noisier than my other keyboard, but I know that's a normal thing for mechanicals, though I can't compare it to other mechanicals, of course. It's easy to set up, and I haven't had any issues with the software. I was able to program the keys easily, and I appreciate the "game mode" key so if I accidentally hit my Windows key, it doesn't interrupt my game.
reviews.author: N. Ruggles
